aboutGame.title: What is Manhwa Legends?
paragraphs: Manhwa Legends is a manhwa-inspired tower defense RPG on Roblox where you summon powerful heroes inspired by Korean manhwa aesthetics. Build your squad, evolve and awaken units, and defend the world across challenging tower defense modes with unique traits and abilities.

Whether you're summoning your first legendary hero, evolving units to unlock powerful traits, or mastering team compositions for difficult tower defense stages, our wiki covers every system with detailed guides, tier lists, codes, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Manhwa Legends.

items.question: What is Manhwa Legends?
items.answer: Manhwa Legends is a manhwa-inspired tower defense RPG on Roblox where you summon powerful heroes inspired by Korean manhwa aesthetics. Build your squad, evolve and awaken units, and defend the world across challenging tower defense modes with unique traits and abilities.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in Manhwa Legends?
items.answer: To redeem codes in Manhwa Legends, look for the Codes or Settings button in the game menu, enter the code exactly as shown, and claim your rewards for Gems, Trait Rerolls, Gold, and other valuable items.

items.question: What are the best units to summon in Manhwa Legends?
items.answer: The best units depend on your playstyle and team composition. Check our Tier List for current rankings of top DPS, support, farming, and boss-focused units. Generally, focus on S and A tier units for efficient progression.

items.question: How does evolution and awakening work in Manhwa Legends?
items.answer: Evolution requires specific materials and unit levels. When you evolve a unit, it gains new traits and improved stats. Awakening further enhances trait effectiveness. Prioritize evolving your strongest units first to tackle harder content.

items.question: Which traits should I look for in Manhwa Legends?
items.answer: Look for traits that match a unit role: attack and crit damage for DPS units, buffs and healing for supports, HP and armor for tanks. Use Trait Rerolls strategically to improve high-tier units.

items.question: What are the best game modes for farming resources?
items.answer: Story Mode is great for early progression, while Infinite Mode offers continuous farming opportunities. Raids and Events often provide exclusive evolution materials and high-value rewards.

items.question: How do I build an effective team in Manhwa Legends?
items.answer: A balanced team typically includes DPS units for damage, support units for buffs and healing, and frontline units for defense. Consider unit synergies and traits when building your squad for different game modes.
